# Checkbox

Native checkboxes and radio buttons with large hit areas, grouped in a fieldset with a legend, plus select-all with an indeterminate state for tables and a dis…

`SongNodes.Checkbox` · Inputs

## Use

```jsx
<SongNodes.Checkbox label={…} checked onChange={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SongNodes.Checkbox" label="{{…}}" checked="{{yes}}" on-change="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Props (CheckboxProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` * | `ReactNode` | Label: positive statement in sentence case. |
| `checked` * | `boolean` | Checked state. |
| `indeterminate` | `boolean` | Mixed state for select-all (sets input.indeterminate). |
| `onChange` * | `(checked: boolean) => void` | Change handler. |
| `hint` | `string` | Hint under the label. |
| `count` | `number` | Count shown in mono after the label. |
| `disabledReason` | `string` | Disabled with the reason as the hint. |
| `radio` | `{ name: string; value: string }` | Render a radio instead (with name and value). |
| `bare` | `boolean` | Label-less box for table cells; ariaLabel is then required. |
| `ariaLabel` | `string` | Accessible name for bare boxes ("Select Bicep – Glue"). |
